#load "References.fsx"

open System
open System.IO
open System.Text.Json
open System.Text.Json.Serialization
open Grace.Shared
open Grace.Types.Usage
open Grace.Types.UsageObservation
open NodaTime.Text

/// Tests whether existing Grace observation records can round-trip decimal-string quantities without changing shared options.
let output = __SOURCE_DIRECTORY__
let originalHandling = Constants.JsonSerializerOptions.NumberHandling
let lossless = JsonSerializerOptions(Constants.JsonSerializerOptions)
lossless.NumberHandling <- JsonNumberHandling.AllowReadingFromString ||| JsonNumberHandling.WriteAsString
let started = InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Parse("2026-09-07T15:00:00.123456789Z").Value
let finished = InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Parse("2026-09-07T15:00:01.987654321Z").Value

/// Fails the disposable witness immediately if an observed codec property differs.
let require label condition =
    if not condition then failwith label
    printfn "PASS: %s" label

for label, amount, count in [ "zero", 0L, 0L; "above-js-safe", 9007199254740993L, 1L; "max-int64", Int64.MaxValue, Int64.MaxValue ] do
    let value: DirectoryVersionSizeObservation =
        { ObservationId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
          Scope = { OwnerId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"; OrganizationId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"; RepositoryId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004" }
          DeclaredLogicalBytes = amount; DistinctContentCount = count
          EnumerationStartedAt = started; EnumerationFinishedAt = finished }
    require (label + " validates") (DirectoryVersionSizeObservation.Validate(value) = Ok())
    for wire, options in [ "numeric", Constants.JsonSerializerOptions; "string", lossless ] do
        let json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, options)
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(output, label + "-" + wire + ".json"), json)
        let restored = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<DirectoryVersionSizeObservation>(json, Constants.JsonSerializerOptions)
        require (label + " " + wire + " existing Grace reader exact round-trip") (restored = value)
        use parsed = JsonDocument.Parse(json)
        let bytes = parsed.RootElement.GetProperty("DeclaredLogicalBytes")
        let expectedKind = if wire = "string" then JsonValueKind.String else JsonValueKind.Number
        require (label + " " + wire + " explicit quantity token") (bytes.ValueKind = expectedKind)
        require (label + " " + wire + " all timestamp digits") (parsed.RootElement.GetProperty("EnumerationStartedAt").GetString() = "2026-09-07T15:00:00.123456789Z")

require "shared serializer options remain unchanged" (Constants.JsonSerializerOptions.NumberHandling = originalHandling)
printfn "VERDICT: codec feasibility proven for existing record; HTTP, authorization, SDK transport and generated clients were not executed."

#load "References.fsx"
#load "PermissionEvaluator.Server.fs"

open System
open System.IO
open System.Threading
open System.Threading.Tasks
open System.Text.Json
open Grace.Server.Security
open Grace.Shared
open Grace.Types.Authorization
open Grace.Types.Common
open Grace.Types.Usage
open Grace.Types.UsageObservation
open NodaTime.Text

/// Captures whether two existing permission evaluations prevent disclosure after an intervening revocation.
let output = __SOURCE_DIRECTORY__
let ownerId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
let organizationId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"
let repositoryId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004"
let otherId = Guid.Parse "20000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
let principal = { PrincipalType = PrincipalType.User; PrincipalId = "owner-reader" }
let scope: UsageFactScope = { OwnerId = ownerId; OrganizationId = organizationId; RepositoryId = repositoryId }
let instant = InstantPattern.ExtendedIso.Parse("2026-09-07T16:00:00.123456789Z").Value
let stored: DirectoryVersionSizeObservation =
    { ObservationId = Guid.Parse "10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
      Scope = scope; DeclaredLogicalBytes = 9007199254740993L; DistinctContentCount = 1L
      EnumerationStartedAt = instant; EnumerationFinishedAt = instant }
let results = ResizeArray<obj>()

/// Creates a real existing role assignment without adding a permission or domain type.
let assignment role assignmentScope =
    { Principal = principal; Scope = assignmentScope; RoleId = role
      Source = "disposable-experiment"; SourceDetail = None; CreatedAt = instant }

/// Fails immediately if a named case violates the expected status, disclosure or selected read sequence.
let require label condition = if not condition then failwith label

/// Executes the proposed read ordering with actual GracePermissionEvaluator and controlled assignment/lookup boundaries.
let runCase label (assignments: RoleAssignment list) (requestedScope: UsageFactScope) (row: DirectoryVersionSizeObservation option) failAt revokeAt cancelAt authenticated =
    task {
        let mutable activeAssignments = assignments
        let effects = ResizeArray<string>()
        let mutable evaluations = 0
        let mutable lookups = 0
        use cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource()
        /// Uses the evaluator's real scope selection and role catalog while controlling current assignment values.
        let fetch (queryScope: Scope, _: CorrelationId) =
            task {
                effects.Add $"assignments:{queryScope}"
                if failAt = "permission" || (failAt = "second-permission" && evaluations = 2) then failwith "controlled assignment read failure"
                return activeAssignments |> List.filter (fun value -> value.Scope = queryScope)
            }
        let evaluator = GracePermissionEvaluator(fetch, fun _ -> Task.FromResult []) :> IGracePermissionEvaluator
        /// Changes permission or cancellation exactly at a named awaited boundary, with no sleeps.
        let boundary name =
            effects.Add name
            if revokeAt = name then activeAssignments <- []
            if cancelAt = name then cancellation.Cancel()
            if failAt = name then failwith ("controlled failure:" + name)
            cancellation.Token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
        /// Executes a fresh current-assignment evaluation for the requested recorded owner.
        let check () =
            task {
                evaluations <- evaluations + 1
                let! decision = evaluator.CheckAsync([principal], Set.empty, Operation.OwnerAdmin, Resource.Owner requestedScope.OwnerId)
                return match decision with Allowed _ -> true | Denied _ -> false
            }
        let! status, body =
            task {
                try
                    boundary "start"
                    if not authenticated then return 401, None
                    else
                        let! allowed = check ()
                        boundary "after-first-check"
                        if not allowed then return 403, None
                        else
                            boundary "before-lookup"
                            lookups <- lookups + 1
                            let! found = Task.FromResult row
                            boundary "after-lookup"
                            let! stillAllowed = if failAt = "omit-second-check" then Task.FromResult true else check ()
                            boundary "after-second-check"
                            if not stillAllowed then return 403, None
                            else
                                match found with
                                | Some value when value.Scope = requestedScope && value.ObservationId = stored.ObservationId ->
                                    boundary "before-publication"
                                    return 200, Some value
                                | _ -> return 404, None
                with _ -> return 503, None
            }
        results.Add(box {| Case = label; Status = status; Disclosed = body.IsSome; Evaluations = evaluations; Lookups = lookups; Effects = effects.ToArray() |})
        return status, body, evaluations, lookups
    }

/// Checks a case's observable result and confirms that rejected requests never disclose the stored record.
let verify label expectedStatus expectedLookups (work: Task<int * DirectoryVersionSizeObservation option * int * int>) =
    let status, body, evaluations, lookups = work |> Async.AwaitTask |> Async.RunSynchronously
    require (label + " status") (status = expectedStatus)
    require (label + " lookups") (lookups = expectedLookups)
    require (label + " disclosure") (body.IsSome = (expectedStatus = 200))
    if expectedStatus = 200 then require (label + " exact immutable record") (body = Some stored)
    printfn "PASS: %s (%d; evaluations=%d; lookups=%d)" label status evaluations lookups

let owner = [assignment "OwnerAdmin" (Scope.Owner ownerId)]
let cases =
    [ "owner admin exact historical record", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "", "", true, 200, 1
      "owner reader is insufficient", [assignment "OwnerReader" (Scope.Owner ownerId)], scope, Some stored, "", "", "", true, 403, 0
      "repository admin is insufficient", [assignment "RepositoryAdmin" (Scope.Repository(ownerId, organizationId, repositoryId))], scope, Some stored, "", "", "", true, 403, 0
      "other owner cannot read requested owner", [assignment "OwnerAdmin" (Scope.Owner otherId)], scope, Some stored, "", "", "", true, 403, 0
      "system admin retains existing permission", [assignment "SystemAdmin" Scope.System], scope, Some stored, "", "", "", true, 200, 1
      "system operator retains existing permission", [assignment "SystemOperator" Scope.System], scope, Some stored, "", "", "", true, 200, 1
      "unauthenticated never evaluates or reads", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "", "", false, 401, 0
      "permission failure denies before SQL", owner, scope, Some stored, "permission", "", "", true, 403, 0
      "missing row is not found", owner, scope, None, "", "", "", true, 404, 1
      "different stored owner is not found", owner, scope, Some {stored with Scope = {scope with OwnerId = otherId}}, "", "", "", true, 404, 1
      "different organization is not found", owner, scope, Some {stored with Scope = {scope with OrganizationId = otherId}}, "", "", "", true, 404, 1
      "different repository is not found", owner, scope, Some {stored with Scope = {scope with RepositoryId = otherId}}, "", "", "", true, 404, 1
      "different observation ID is not found", owner, scope, Some {stored with ObservationId = otherId}, "", "", "", true, 404, 1
      "revoked after first check prevents publication", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "after-first-check", "", true, 403, 1
      "revoked after lookup prevents publication", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "after-lookup", "", true, 403, 1
      "second permission failure prevents publication", owner, scope, Some stored, "second-permission", "", "", true, 403, 1
      "negative control omitted recheck discloses revoked reading", owner, scope, Some stored, "omit-second-check", "after-lookup", "", true, 200, 1
      "revocation after final check is outside atomic guarantee", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "after-second-check", "", true, 200, 1
      "failure before lookup preserves read-only state", owner, scope, Some stored, "before-lookup", "", "", true, 503, 0
      "failure after lookup discloses nothing", owner, scope, Some stored, "after-lookup", "", "", true, 503, 1
      "failure before publication discloses nothing", owner, scope, Some stored, "before-publication", "", "", true, 503, 1
      "cancelled before lookup reads nothing", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "", "before-lookup", true, 503, 0
      "cancelled after lookup discloses nothing", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "", "after-lookup", true, 503, 1
      "cancelled before publication discloses nothing", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "", "before-publication", true, 503, 1
      "fresh retry after failures uses same unchanged record", owner, scope, Some stored, "", "", "", true, 200, 1 ]
for label, roles, requested, row, failure, revocation, cancellation, authenticated, status, lookups in cases do
    verify label status lookups (runCase label roles requested row failure revocation cancellation authenticated)

File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(output, "results.json"), JsonSerializer.Serialize(results, JsonSerializerOptions(WriteIndented = true)))
printfn "VERDICT: %d cases passed with actual Grace permission evaluation; HTTP and SQL lookup were modeled; no production route was added." results.Count

Source-loaded GracePermissionEvaluator, compiled RoleCatalog and authorization types, with controlled existing callback inputs.
Native Node JSON.parse and actual freshly generated TypeScript FromJSON/ToJSON functions over six complete Grace outputs.
modeled: Authentication, SQL lookup, assignment storage, publication and historical repository deletion/reassignment.
Failure/cancellation/revocation at deterministic in-memory boundaries; no actor concurrency, SQL wait or token-refresh execution.
limits: The compiled dependency set was captured at PR #1063; this run verifies its hashes, not a fresh build at the selected base.
Permission recheck is not atomic with delivery, does not refresh token/group claims, and does not make scoped assignment reads atomic.
The two generated schemas are minimal OpenAPI 3.1.0 fixtures. Production source is 3.2.0 and the full compatibility projection is 3.1.2.
Fixture regexes do not define the selected production Instant range or validate the complete Int64 upper bound.

No HTTP envelope, hosted auth, actor assignment fetch, SQL, F# SDK transport, CLI output, supported TypeScript facade, full repository OpenAPI/matrix freshness, provider access or combined Library runtime is certified.
Negative numeric/date-time and omitted-recheck cases deliberately demonstrate incorrect alternatives; a PASS confirms the expected failure mode, not product acceptance.
No new production types or new named handwritten harness types. The embedded evaluator is unchanged existing Grace source. Generated interfaces/API/runtime declarations are disposable output.
No shared Aspire or SQL/Cosmos fixture was started. Original inputs/archives were preserved.
